modelDescription: The Winchester XPR Extreme SR rifle is a step forward in design and manufacturing. Its spiral fluted barrel eliminates the amount of metal, creating a lightweight barrel. Pairing the performance of the XPR with Mossy Oak Bottomland camouflage gives you a lethal advantage.
